consequence.statement: The metric lbipam_ips_used_total is now exposed as lbipam_ips_used, so anything that references the old metric name needs review.
consequence.remediation: Update monitoring queries, dashboards and alerts to use lbipam_ips_used.

original.statement: In Cilium 1.17.0 the metric lbipam_ips_used_total has been renamed to lbipam_ips_used.

decision.reason: [ev-1bf87d491deb] only says that `lbipam_ips_used_total` has been renamed to `lbipam_ips_used`. It appears in the 'Changed Metrics' section alongside similar renames ([ev-875bb56564b0], [ev-2e2ab2d37845]). The evidence does not say that any scrape, alert or integration fails, so a failure kind such as P5's setting-ignored would claim more than the text supports. The metric is still exposed under a new name, and references to the old name should be reviewed. A low-severity behavior-change with review class is the supported reading.
